answer.says: Ramesh, the day has been long, and my body is reminding me that I am not yet a spirit. Please, prepare a plate for me: rice, the dal, and perhaps an egg if it is not too much trouble.
answer.thought: The hunger is a concrete negation of my abstract plans. I have walked three kilometres and debated with a stranger, but the body remains the ground of my existence. I will not pretend to be a pure mind while my stomach growls.
